title: Shows like Ars Paradoxica
description: Idea-forward sci-fi mysteries for listeners who like the thinking as much as the plot movement.
label: Science-first intrigue

showReasons.from-now: A shorter time-dislocation story when you want the conceptual hook without the same scope.
showReasons.red-valley: Keeps the secret-science unease and institutional weirdness alive.
showReasons.case-63: A cleaner paradox-thriller branch if the time-travel tension is what you want more of.
showReasons.the-program-audio-series: Leans harder into system design and speculative consequences than character warmth.
showReasons.the-bright-sessions: A more emotional, character-first branch for listeners who liked the careful sci-fi construction.
showReasons.midst: A stranger, more formally daring branch once the appetite shifts from science to worldview.
showReasons.out-of-place: A plot-led speculative investigation belongs here for listeners who want ideas and institutions to drive the mystery.
